description: T4 (Dakka Time) step 4 'aim_da_rest' spotlights the weapon tree, which spans HUD_Right's whole inner width. Before the fix the ring was drawn at anchor.grow(6..11) with no clamp, so its left edge landed on the board (map showing through beside weapon rows that stop short of it) and its right edge fell past the viewport — HUD_Right is flush with the right screen edge. The instructor card had the matching problem: fixed 588px wide and centred on the viewport, it slid over HUD_Right once the logical viewport shrank below ~1416px, which is what the Steam Deck's pad UI-scale boost (and the UI Scale slider) does. This drives the lesson to step 4 and asserts, at the default canvas AND at Deck-class shrunken canvases, that the ring stays inside HUD_Right and on-screen and that the card never overlaps the side HUD panels. content_scale_factor is set directly because the scenario runner deliberately suppresses the pad text boost (SettingsService._pad_text_boost_active).

steps.comment: current home of the Tutorial button — the older tutorial scenarios still click ButtonSection/TutorialButton, which the menu reorganisation moved

REAL click path, not dispatch_action. This matters: dispatch_action(ASSIGN_TARGET) skips _select_target_for_current_weapon, which is what reveals the 'Same target for all: Apply to N Remaining Weapons' row — and that row is part of what overflows the panel. An earlier pass at this bug used dispatch_action to navigate here and never saw the clipping the player reported.
